sources.retrieval_method: HTTP 200 live HTML response, normalized to visible text

Free U.S. Shipping Over $250 - Qualifying orders of $250 or more receive free shipping automatically at checkout.
Third-Party Batch Documentation - Peptira publishes batch-specific quality and identity reports so shoppers can review the available documentation before ordering.

limitations: This repository did not enter checkout, make a purchase, authenticate, or independently verify the code.

The page's uses and verification counts were not treated as independent evidence.

conflicts.detail: The live page showed a November 11-13 BOGO plus 10% offer, while the search index retained an expired September Labor Day stack.
